title: An owned zero command must retain low-intent allocation at a centered static target
symptom: Small wrong physical input moves an initially centered static target away and triggers correction after the AI solver has zero remaining work.

facts.claim: 505 of 512 complete native static-plant cases exceed the predeclared 0.05 px hold tolerance, maximum 4.25013208 px, with every BodyLock/identity/direct-observation trigger passing.
The original sole arbiter returns unweighted raw M whenever shaped AI is sub-material, including a true zero solver request at D.
Every RED and GREEN primary case keeps exact raw physical input on ADS release; four seeds, both axes/curves, and matched source/effect cadence are explicit.

inferences.claim: Loss of target allocation at an owned zero is the cause of this native static-plant defect. A shaped zero or canceled position/motion sum alone cannot establish arrival.

unknowns.question: Whether this defect caused the BO7 replay two-stage movement is unproven without its matching tick inputs and runtime identity.
Broader micro-motion tolerance, image jitter and human acceleration in the full native chain remain unvalidated.

trigger_assertions: Every case has >100 BodyLock ticks and >100 held-input BodyLock ticks
Every case has >10 direct observations, stable nonzero target identity and finite bounded output
Every case retains exact physical right stick on physical ADS release

covariates.freshness: direct fresh frame every seeded 5/8/16 ms, held snapshot between source frames
covariates.target_generation: single constant selector generation 991; stable generated target id asserted
covariates.right_stick_manual: zero before 64 ms, then seeded 0.0200..0.1399 on one axis, sign alternates every 120 ms
covariates.controller_mode: actual ADS admission -> BodyLock; physical ADS release countercontrol
covariates.refresh_rate_hz: native controller 1000 Hz, source period 5/8/16 ms; 600/2400 ms scenarios
covariates.logging_mode: offline JSON only, runtime telemetry off

fixture.scope: Unchanged centered_native_hold function and oracles. New producer semantics and supplemental countercontrols are separately registered.

counterfactuals.expected: all 512 cases immediately return exact raw right stick

counterfactuals.change: start real target motion after an observed exact hold
counterfactuals.expected: 64 supplemental cases resume directionally correct output and establish aligned motion evidence within frozen deadlines

counterfactuals.change: remove motion evidence, use identity-only cue, or leave any unfinished position/motion work
counterfactuals.expected: solver does not label the axis as a position hold

acceptance: Only the exact zero-hold native invariant is offline complete; BO7 jitter, new onset curve and overall product/live acceptance remain open.
